workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.scope: Research situations with a defined starting point and deliverable; interface operations belong inside each scenario.

chapters.title: Workflow cookbook
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Workflow cookbook
topics.scope: Choose by research question, input type, expected output, and available resources.

topics.title: Your first reproducible analysis
topics.scope: A small CSV example from import to inspection, execution, saved figure, and rerun verification.

chapters.title: Prepare a focused reading pack for a journal club
chapters.scope: For an upcoming journal club, select papers around one question, review agent suggestions, collect available full text and prepare a reading order with discussion questions.

chapters.title: Build a core reading list for a new research topic
chapters.scope: When starting an unfamiliar topic, collect seed papers, map key themes and save a curated reading list linked to the project. Import and tagging are steps within this scenario.

chapters.title: Search within specified journals and dates
chapters.scope: Run a bounded PubMed search, screen every returned record and retain uncertain eligibility decisions.

chapters.title: Screen papers with a smart collection
chapters.scope: Define eligibility, run a bounded screening pass, review decisions and export the selected papers.

chapters.title: Take over and organize a paper collection
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Take over a previous researcher's literature collection
topics.scope: Given PDFs and citation exports from a previous researcher, reconstruct a usable project library and produce a list of missing or ambiguous records.

topics.title: Make a fragmented paper collection usable again
topics.scope: Given mixed folders, incomplete citations and missing attachments, reconcile records and full text into topic collections with an explicit unresolved-items list.

chapters.title: Consolidate search batches for a review project
chapters.scope: Combine records from several searches or databases into a deduplicated candidate set, retaining search provenance and a documented screening handoff.

chapters.title: Extend an existing evidence base
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Reuse a literature base for a related research question
topics.scope: When a related project starts, identify relevant papers in the existing library, link them without duplicating records and document evidence gaps specific to the new question.

topics.title: Refresh the evidence base before a project milestone
topics.scope: Before a proposal or progress review, run a fresh search, compare new findings with the saved collection and prepare a dated additions-and-gaps note. This is a manual workflow, not scheduled monitoring.

chapters.title: Literature review to evidence table
chapters.scope: Define a question, search and screen records, extract evidence, cite sources, and report access gaps.

chapters.title: Read papers and verify claims
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Read and compare papers
topics.scope: Extract methods, populations, findings and limitations from provided papers; retain page-level evidence.

topics.title: Check whether a paper supports a claim
topics.scope: Given a claim in a draft or meeting note, locate the relevant PDF passages and methods, retain page evidence and produce a supported, qualified or unsupported finding.

chapters.title: Retrieve structured database records
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Search scientific databases
topics.scope: Select a data source, formulate bounded queries, resolve identifiers, and save traceable records.

topics.title: Resolve a mismatch between a paper and a database
topics.scope: When a paper and a database disagree about a gene, compound or trial, reconcile identifiers and versions and document what remains unresolved.

chapters.title: Cross-check two scientific data sources
chapters.scope: Align definitions, units, years and reference periods before comparing NASA and HadCRUT annual temperature records.

chapters.title: Build an indication dossier
chapters.scope: Combine biology, epidemiology, trials and treatment evidence with source dates and unresolved gaps.

chapters.title: Prepare references for submission
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Adapt a bibliography to a target journal
topics.scope: Use trusted Library item IDs and supported CSL styles. Cover formatted citations, DOCX with semantic citation markers, and an Overleaf-compatible LaTeX bundle; verify output fields and style requirements.

topics.title: Audit a manuscript's references before submission
topics.scope: Given a manuscript and its source library, reconcile cited records, bibliographic fields, duplicates and accessible evidence, then produce a corrected bibliography and an exceptions list.

chapters.title: Check sample quality in a gene-count matrix
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Audit and clean a dataset
topics.scope: Check types, missingness, duplicates and units; preserve raw inputs and record exclusions.

topics.title: Analyze with Python and R
topics.scope: Prepare runtimes, inspect variables, execute incrementally, recover errors and save reusable scripts.

chapters.title: Statistical analysis and validation
chapters.scope: State assumptions, select a method, check diagnostics, report uncertainty, and retain runnable code.

chapters.title: Reproduce a published result
chapters.scope: Inventory paper, code and data; define acceptance criteria, run a pilot and distinguish matches from deviations.

chapters.title: Extend an analysis with an installed Specialist
chapters.scope: Existing Methods, QC PCA, matrix and evidence-planning examples.

chapters.title: Find public omics data and build a file inventory
chapters.scope: Discover public ENA runs and inspect ENA and PRIDE file inventories, source locations, sizes and checksums.

chapters.title: Find a protein sequence and complete a BLAST search
chapters.scope: Resolve a UniProt protein, retrieve FASTA and inspect a completed BLAST alignment report.

chapters.title: Align multiple sequences
chapters.scope: Compare three reviewed protein sequences and inspect conserved positions.

chapters.title: Run functional enrichment for a candidate gene set
chapters.scope: Run g:Profiler enrichment and inspect mappings, corrected probabilities, background and source versions.

chapters.title: Check species, reference genome and chromosome identifiers
chapters.scope: Resolve a taxon, versioned reference assembly and chromosome aliases before analysis.

chapters.title: Sequence quality and annotation
chapters.scope: Inspect FASTA records, alphabets and lengths; resolve annotation sources and preserve failed records.

chapters.title: Single-cell analysis
chapters.scope: Check expression inputs and metadata, choose scGPT or scvi-tools where appropriate, and validate outputs. Requires compatible single-cell input, a configured Python environment and the selected Skill dependencies; scientific execution remains pending.

chapters.title: Protein and complex prediction
chapters.scope: Choose an available prediction Skill, check inputs and compute requirements, then inspect confidence and limitations. Requires the selected package, model weights and suitable local or remote compute; listing a Skill does not verify prediction execution.

chapters.title: Molecular structures and docking
chapters.scope: Validate molecules, inspect properties and structures, and review docking poses without equating scores with affinity. Separate the local molecule viewer, online chemistry sources and DiffDock execution; docking requires its own dependencies and compute validation.

chapters.title: Create figures with traceable evidence
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Compose and validate scientific figures
topics.scope: Create panels from traceable data, check labels and visual fidelity, and export publication assets.

topics.title: Explain where a figure's result came from
topics.scope: When a collaborator questions a figure, trace the artifact to its execution and inputs, verify versions and prepare an evidence-backed explanation of the calculation.

chapters.title: Write and revise a research report
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Build a report or manuscript narrative
topics.scope: Connect verified findings, figure order, methods and citations; flag unsupported claims.

topics.title: Revise a figure or report after reviewer feedback
topics.scope: Map feedback to saved outputs, make supported edits, compare revisions and prepare a response linking each change to the revised artifact.

chapters.title: Rerun an analysis after the source data changes
chapters.scope: Given an updated dataset, identify stale notebook outputs, rerun dependencies and compare new results with the previous deliverable to explain material changes.

chapters.title: Run and recover remote analyses
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Run an analysis on an SSH host
topics.scope: Check host policy and readiness, stage inputs, monitor execution, and recover outputs into the project. Requires a user-provided reachable SSH host and tested credentials; no remote job has been verified in the current audit.

topics.title: Submit and recover Slurm jobs
topics.scope: Confirm scheduler requirements, submit a bounded job, track its receipt, cancel or recover, and verify files. Requires an actual Slurm cluster, account and scheduler configuration; scheduler execution is not verified by local mode controls.

chapters.title: Delegate and review research work
chapters.scope: With a supported framework and working models, split a bounded task, configure Specialist capabilities, inspect delegated activity and approvals, and reconcile returned evidence. Verify delegation before claiming parallel execution.

chapters.title: Plan and resume an investigation
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Scope a pilot study before committing compute
topics.scope: Turn a broad question and limited resources into a small pilot plan with inputs, deliverables, stop conditions and acceptance checks before expanding the analysis.

topics.title: Resume an unfinished study with a Session Plan
topics.scope: Resume user-initiated work from an approved Session Plan, recorded step status and saved results. Keep a remaining-work note; the plan does not imply unattended scheduling or a separate persistent-goal feature.

topics.title: Resume a study after a break without losing decisions
topics.scope: Reconstruct a paused study from prior sessions, project memory and saved files, then produce a verified current-state note before further analysis.

chapters.title: Compare two analysis methods on the same dataset
chapters.scope: Use the same documented inputs and preprocessing for two methods, execute both, and compare results, assumptions and limitations.

chapters.title: Reuse a validated analysis on a new dataset
chapters.scope: Convert a successful analysis into a reusable Skill, adapt declared inputs and verify the method on a new dataset without silently carrying over old assumptions.

chapters.title: Hand off a reproducible research package
chapters.scope: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

topics.title: Package a reproducible handoff
topics.scope: Collect inputs, scripts, environments, results and limitations; verify the package from a fresh state.

topics.title: Hand an unfinished analysis to a collaborator
topics.scope: Prepare selected conversation evidence, result files, decisions, environment requirements and remaining questions as a reviewable handoff package.
